description: This is The Team², the product of losing our beloved team leader to sickness. We're working on the Health Monitor Project. Hopefully our team leader gets better soon. God Bless.
summary: Health Monitor with full descriptions of the devices used, how to use them, as well as a full-body 3D model connected to the DB that displays the areas of potential problems. We also added an voice-control system using AI to analyze and decode our vocal commands.
details:
Our project is a desktop health-monitoring app designed to help astronauts track their wellbeing during space missions. It records vital signs such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, sleep and hydration, compares them with personal baselines, and displays trends and alerts. An interactive 3D body viewer helps users explore the body systems related to these measurements.

We built the app using Java, JavaFX and SQLite, with JavaScript and Chromium for the 3D viewer. OpenAI API integration adds voice commands for navigating health information and entering readings, with confirmation before saving.

Our team considered accessibility, clear presentation, data accuracy and space-related challenges such as microgravity, isolation and limited medical support. The intended impact is to help crews notice changes earlier and communicate concerns more clearly to medical staff.
